starting-out-vanstrom-klause.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
starting-out-vanstrom-klause.text: Hello there. The name's Vanstrom Klause. How goes it stranger?

starting-out-vanstrom-klause.player: Quite well, thanks for asking. How about you?

starting-out-vanstrom-klause.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
starting-out-vanstrom-klause.text: Hmm, well, I am a little concerned about some friends of mine. They're in dire need of some assistance, but I'm at a loss as to how I can help them.

starting-out-vanstrom-klause.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
starting-out-vanstrom-klause.text: It's a personal tragedy that I have yet to meet them in the flesh. But their exploits make mouth watering stories... The real meat and drink of high adventure and daring... So they say.

starting-out-vanstrom-klause.player: What does that mean exactly? I mean, I have some stories. I'm quite a hero myself, you may actually be talking about me?

starting-out-vanstrom-klause.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
starting-out-vanstrom-klause.text: They're a group of rebels fighting against the vampyres that rule over Morytania. They're known as the Myreque. Some people call them terrorists while others call them freedom fighters!

starting-out-vanstrom-klause.player: I see. And you want to help them?

starting-out-vanstrom-klause.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
starting-out-vanstrom-klause.text: Of course. I'm a big fan of their cause. I was hoping to supply them with some new weapons. Alas, I find that I'm rather lacking in ability when it comes to this kind of thing!

starting-out-vanstrom-klause.prompt: Start the In Search of the Myreque quest?

steps.player: Well perhaps I could take these weapons to the Myreque. What do they need?

steps.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
steps.text: Really? You would help?

steps.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
steps.text: I was hoping to deliver some steel to them. A longsword, two shortswords, a dagger, a mace and a warhammer.

steps.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
steps.text: Though if you wish to do this, I'm afraid you'll need to acquire the weapons yourself. My efforts to procure them have been rather unsuccessful.

steps.player: Right. Get some steel weapons and take them to the Myreque. Where can I find them?

steps.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
steps.text: The vampyres are always hunting them, so they keep themselves hidden. I hear the boatman in Mort'ton has dealings with them though.

steps.player: Well I'd better get going then.

steps.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
steps.text: How wonderful! Perhaps the people of Morytania now have an additional hero that they can come to rely on?

options.text: What else do you know about the Myreque?

steps.player: What else do you know about the Myreque?

steps.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
steps.text: There's always some evil heel ready to grind the face of humanity into the dirt. Here in Morytania, it's the vampyres! They rule over the region with an iron fist, killing any who oppose them.

steps.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
steps.text: The Myreque are the only ones brave enough to stand up to them. They stay in the shadows though, lest the vampyres track them down!

steps.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
steps.text: No one knows for sure how many of them there are. The group hiding in Mort Myre supposedly has six members. There are whispers of more in other parts of Morytania though.

steps.player: And this group in Mort Myre? They're who the weapons are for?

steps.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
steps.text: Yes, indeed! The Myreque are almost certainly able to handle themselves... But they need the tools to do it!

options.text: Remind me, what weapons do I need?

steps.player: Remind me, what weapons do I need?

steps.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
steps.text: You've forgotten already? Ha! That's funny! But I do understand, my memory isn't what it was either!

steps.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
steps.text: I'd suggest a longsword, two shortswords, a dagger, a mace and a warhammer, all made of steel.

steps.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
steps.text: You'll need to obtain the weapons yourself. Fear not though! If you return to me here once you've found them, I'll be sure to give you a nice surprise in return for your help!

options.text: Where can I find this boatman?

steps.player: Where can I find this boatman?

steps.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
steps.text: I hear he lives in Mort'ton. You'll find the town south of here, through Mort Myre. It's a nasty place, but where isn't in Morytania?

steps.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
steps.text: Most of the town has supposedly fallen to some strange affliction. The boatman is apparently one of the few healthy people left!

steps.player: And you say he's had dealings with the Myreque?

steps.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
steps.text: So I hear. There are many who sympathise with their movement. Rumour is that this boatman's been ferrying supplies to their hideout, somewhere in Mort Myre!

steps.player: I wish I could help, but I'm busy at the moment.

steps.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
steps.text: Oh well, I'm sure someone will be along to help soon. Thanks for even considering it though.

starting-out-talking-to-vanstrom-klause-.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
starting-out-talking-to-vanstrom-klause-.text: Hello again. Any luck finding the Myreque?

options.text: What can you tell me about the Myreque?
Remind me, what weapons do I need?
Where can I find the Myreque?

convincing-cyreg-paddlehorn-talking-to-c.player: Hello there. I'm guessing you're the boatman?

convincing-cyreg-paddlehorn-talking-to-c.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
convincing-cyreg-paddlehorn-talking-to-c.text: Well I am 'a' boatman. I don't know about 'the' boatman though. Why do you ask anyway?

convincing-cyreg-paddlehorn-talking-to-c.player: I hear you have dealings with the Myreque. I was hoping to take some weapons to them.

convincing-cyreg-paddlehorn-talking-to-c.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
convincing-cyreg-paddlehorn-talking-to-c.text: Hmm, I'm sure I don't know what you're talking about.

convincing-cyreg-paddlehorn-talking-to-c.player: Come on, I know you're in cahoots with them. It's important that I get these weapons to them.

convincing-cyreg-paddlehorn-talking-to-c.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
convincing-cyreg-paddlehorn-talking-to-c.text: Well... Okay, I may have done some work for them before. It's too dangerous now though. I'm sorry, I can't help you.

options.text: Oh come on, you can tell me!

steps.player: Oh come on, you can tell me!

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: I'm sorry, I just can't... They're watching us you know... Eyes everywhere!

options.text: Well, I guess they'll just die without weapons.

steps.player: Well, I guess they'll just die without weapons.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Hmm, you don't seem too concerned about their welfare. I'm glad I didn't tell you where they are. In any case, they're resourceful, they can look after themselves.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: They're resourceful folks, that's all I'm saying. The leader of their group, Veliaf, looks after them well.

options.text: Oh come on, you can tell me!
Resourceful enough to get their own steel weapons?

steps.player: Resourceful enough to get their own steel weapons?

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Maybe they are... What do you care anyway? They've been up against it ever since they got started.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: All of 'em have suffered more loss and heartache than you'll ever know. Now, leave me be!

options.text: What have they been up against?

steps.player: What have they been up against?

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: You're clearly not from around here or you wouldn't be asking such foolish questions.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Drakan. That's what they've been up against.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Lord Lowerniel Drakan. Leader of the vampyres and ruler of Morytania. His reign over these lands means we all live in fear.

options.text: What kind of loss and heartache have they suffered?

steps.player: What kind of loss and heartache have they suffered?

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: The worst kind. Most have lost members of their family.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Take Sani Piliu for example. she was orphaned overnight when a vampyre went on the rampage. Imagine that, losing your entire family in one night. Terrible!

steps.player: It sounds awful... Who is Sani Piliu?

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: She's the only female member of the Myreque. Her agility and light fingers have got them out of quite a few sticky situations.

options.text: If you don't tell me, their deaths are on your head!

steps.player: If you don't tell me, their deaths are on your head!

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: There's death aplenty in this forsaken place... What do I care that some fool hardy vigilantes decided to go it alone against the Drakans?

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Stupidity of youth is to blame. I won't carry it on my shoulders!

options.text: One mans vigilante is another mans freedom fighter!

steps.player: One man's vigilante is another man's freedom fighter!

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Aye, you can see it from both sides I suppose. But many of us consider it fool hardy to fight for something we'll never get.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: I remember a conversation I had with Polmafi, a scholar, such as he was. Even he agrees that the chances are slim.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Polmafi Ferdygris is one of the Myreque. He's a technical sort and advises on all sorts of things to Veliaf. He was a scholar before he became a renegade.

options.text: What do you know of the Drakans?

steps.player: What do you know of the Drakans?

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: They're the family that leads the vampyres. They're the ones to whom the blood tithes are paid. Too much I have told you already!

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Ignorance is better than these truths I tell you! I can pretend once more that I am a free man and some relief from this gloom can I feel again.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Be gone with you now and leave me with my dreams.

options.text: What kind of a man are you to say that you don't care?

steps.player: What kind of a man are you to say that you don't care?

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Don't dare to judge me young fool... what do you know of the heartache I carry? I want to help them! I did help them! But my part is done now. To do any more is to risk death!

steps.player: You're risking death either way. Better to risk it and help the cause, than to stand by and do nothing.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Hmmm. Very well, if you would take your chance to help these strangers, who am I to stop you?

steps.player: So you'll help me? Will you take me to them?

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: No, I won't take you, but you can use my boat.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: You'll be going through Mort Myre though, so I won't be letting you go unless you've got some defence against the ghasts.
If the player does not have a druid pouch in their inventory:

steps.player: I don't have anything which I can use against them.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Well return to me once you have.
If the player has a Druid Pouch in their inventory:
You show the boatman your druid pouch.

steps.player: I have this druid pouch! This turns the ghasts visible and I can kill them once I can see them.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Very well, you can go! But you'll need to bring me six wooden planks first.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: The boat took some damage on my last trip. It needs repairing. There's also a bridge you'll need to cross later in your journey. It's rotten and will likely need repairs.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Three of the planks are for the boat and three are for the bridge. I suggest you bring some tools and steel nails along as well.

options.text: Here are some planks for you.

steps.player: Here are some planks for you.

steps.text: The boatman takes three wooden planks from you and uses them to fix his boat.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Right. You can take the boat. Just jump in when you're ready to leave.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Go as far north as you can and you'll arrive at the Hollows. Keep heading north on foot, over the rotten bridge, and you'll eventually reach an odd looking tree. That is where you'll find the Myreque.

options.text: Why do you say that this place is forsaken?

steps.player: Why do you say that this place is forsaken?

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: All of these lands are forsaken of Saradomin's kindness, only cold death from evil do we now feel.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Those lucky ones to the west of the Salve little realise their fate if the river should one day become tainted.

options.text: I just want to help them, I think they need help.
I'll give you some cash if you tell me.
I just want to help them, I think they need help.
I'll give you some cash if you tell me.

steps.player: I'll give you some cash if you tell me.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: You think you can buy me?

steps.player: Err, no. I just want to compensate you for your trouble.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: You keep your money and I'll keep my secrets.

options.text: I just want to help them, I think they need help.

steps.player: I just want to help them, I think they need help.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Aye, everyone in these lands needs help. I'm sorry though, it's just not safe and it's not likely to get safer any time soon.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Look, I feel for them, I really do. They're fighting the good fight out there and unfortunately, some of them probably won't live through it.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Ivan in particular I feel sorry for. He's the youngest of their group and he's seen too few winters to be involved in such toil.

steps.player: Then tell me how to find them. I can help them.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: I support their cause. That doesn't mean I want to die for them though. I'm sorry, but I will not risk the wrath of the vampyres.

convincing-cyreg-paddlehorn-talking-to-c.player: Please. I need to know how to find the Myreque.

convincing-cyreg-paddlehorn-talking-to-c.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
convincing-cyreg-paddlehorn-talking-to-c.text: I'm sorry, but I can't help you. I guess you're all out of luck.

convincing-cyreg-paddlehorn-talking-to-c.player: So, will you take me to the Myreque?

convincing-cyreg-paddlehorn-talking-to-c.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
convincing-cyreg-paddlehorn-talking-to-c.text: No, I won't take you, but you can use my boat.

convincing-cyreg-paddlehorn-talking-to-c.player: Can I ask you some more questions?

options.text: Where am I meant to be going?

steps.player: Where am I meant to be going?

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Take my boat as far north as you can and you'll arrive at the Hollows. Keep heading north on foot, over the rotten bridge, and you'll eventually reach an odd looking tree. That is where you'll find the Myreque.

options.text: Tell me more about the Myreque.

steps.player: Tell me more about the Myreque.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: What do you want to know?

options.text: Why are they called the Myreque?

steps.player: Why are they called the Myreque?

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: It's a name the locals gave them. It means 'hidden in the myre'. Nothing fancy, it's just because that's where they hide, in Mort Myre.

options.text: Tell me about the members of the Myreque

steps.player: Tell me about the members of the Myreque.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Well you have Radigad Ponfit. He was a mercenary from Asgarnia but he joined up with the Myreque to settle some mysterious score with the Drakans.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Then there's Veliaf Hurtz, the leader of the group. He's been fighting the fight longer than any of them.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Next there's Ivan Strom. He's the youngest. I hear he's an aspiring priest. Not that there's much time for that around here.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: You've also got Sani Piliu, the only female of the group. She's a bit of a shady one. I reckon she was a thief before the Myreque found her.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: There's Harold Evans. Used to be part of some militia but was kicked out for being too hot-headed. Now he's the main fighter for the Myreque.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: Finally, you have Polmafi Ferdygris. He's the brains of the operation in many ways. Believe it or not, he used to be a scholar.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: In Mort Myre it is. I sometimes hear rumour of more groups hidden in other parts of Morytania. Who knows if that's true though.

options.condition: If the player has asked a question (replaces 'I'll be back later'):

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: They're the family of vampyres that rules all of Morytania. Lowerniel Drakan is the head of the family. Every bit of misery in this place is caused by him.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: No one out here ever sees the Drakans, but their presence is always felt. Their castle towers over all of the region. A constant reminder of their tyranny.

steps.speaker: Cyreg Paddlehorn
steps.text: I'm just a humble boatman. Cyreg Paddlehorn is my name. Like most of the Paddlehorns before me, I make my living by tacking the swamps of Mort Myre.

options.condition: If the player has asked a question (replaces 'I'll be back later'):

options.text: I've come to help the Myreque. I've brought weapons.

steps.player: I've come to help the Myreque. I've brought weapons.

steps.speaker: Curpile Fyod
steps.text: Okay, I see ya got some weapons. But here's da thing. These guys out here, they don't wanna be found. They paid me good money to keep em hidden.

steps.speaker: Curpile Fyod

convincing-curpile-fyod-talking-to-curpi.speaker: Curpile Fyod

myreque-hideout-when-first-entering-the-.speaker: Harold Evans
myreque-hideout-when-first-entering-the-.text: Hey! Who are you and why are you here?

myreque-hideout-when-first-entering-the-.player: It's okay. I'm a friend. I'm here to deliver some weapons to you.

myreque-hideout-when-first-entering-the-.speaker: Harold Evans
myreque-hideout-when-first-entering-the-.text: Weapons? You'd better talk to Veliaf then. I'll be keeping an eye on you though, so don't go trying anything.

myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.speaker: Harold Evans
myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.text: I'm keeping my eye on you. Nothing personal. We just need to be careful with newcomers. Anyway, Veliaf will want to speak to you.

myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.speaker: Radigad Ponfit
myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.text: Greetings! Good to see some new blood. You'd better speak with Veliaf. He's in charge here.

myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.speaker: Polmafi Ferdygris
myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.text: Hello there. Here to help the cause are you? Speak to Veliaf. He'll sort you out.

myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.speaker: Sani Piliu
myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.text: Hi there. You're new here aren't you? You'd best go and talk with Veliaf.

myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.speaker: Ivan Strom
myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.text: Oh... Hello. Sorry, but I'm not sure if I'm supposed to be talking to you. You'd better speak to Veliaf.

myreque-hideout-talking-to-veliaf.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
myreque-hideout-talking-to-veliaf.text: You... I saw you come in. Harold didn't kill you though so I'm guessing you're no enemy. Who are you?

myreque-hideout-talking-to-veliaf.player: I'm [player name]. Don't worry, I'm a friend. I was asked to bring you some weapons.

myreque-hideout-talking-to-veliaf.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
myreque-hideout-talking-to-veliaf.text: It's true that we could do with some supplies. Thank you for bringing them here. I'll have a proper look over them in a moment but there's something I must finish first.

myreque-hideout-talking-to-veliaf.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
myreque-hideout-talking-to-veliaf.text: Feel free to introduce yourself to the others in the meantime.

myreque-hideout-talking-to-veliaf-talkin.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
myreque-hideout-talking-to-veliaf-talkin.text: Ah, well met. We'll discuss those weapons shortly. I need to finish something first though. Feel free to introduce yourself to the others in the meantime.

myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.text: If first time speaking:

steps.speaker: Harold Evans
steps.text: Hello there. Forgive me if I seem cautious of you. We just need to be careful with newcomers.

steps.player: It's fine. Do you mind if I ask a few questions?

myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.text: If speaking again:

steps.speaker: Harold Evans
steps.text: Hello there. What can I do for you?

steps.player: I'd like to ask a few questions if that's okay?

myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.speaker: Harold Evans
myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.text: Sure. I'll do my best to answer them.

steps.speaker: Harold Evans
steps.text: Cheating death seems to be my main role. I'm the main fighter for the group so I'm always in the thick of it. It's gone okay for me so far though.

options.text: What can you tell me about this group?

steps.player: What can you tell me about this group?

steps.speaker: Harold Evans
steps.text: We're a good team, though many of the others haven't had any proper training before. I used to be in a militia so I've been trying to share my knowledge as best I can.

steps.speaker: Harold Evans
steps.text: In most cases we end up having to improvise though. Thankfully, this lot are good at that. Ivan over there, he saved our bacon in a recent run in with some juves.

steps.speaker: Harold Evans
steps.text: Juveniles, the lowest form of vampyre. We come across them quite often around here. They may be the weakest vampyres but they're still very dangerous.

steps.speaker: Harold Evans
steps.text: They're stronger and faster than many well trained soldiers, and twice as bloodthirsty.

options.text: What's your grasp of the situation?

steps.player: What's your grasp of the situation?

steps.speaker: Harold Evans
steps.text: The situation is grave. It would be dangerous to think differently.

steps.speaker: Harold Evans
steps.text: We're really up against it, but we have no choice. This is a battle for our very existence and we need to employ any tactics to achieve our goal.

steps.speaker: Harold Evans
steps.text: Yes, I hear them all the time. I don't pay any attention to them though.

options.condition: If the player has asked a question (replaces 'I'll be back later'):

myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.text: If first time speaking:

steps.speaker: Radigad Ponfit
steps.text: Ah, I see you've introduced yourself to Veliaf. Are you planning to join the fray against the Drakans?

steps.player: Maybe. I'd like to ask a few questions if that's okay?

myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.text: If speaking again:

steps.speaker: Radigad Ponfit
steps.text: Hello again! How can I be of service to you?

steps.player: I'd like to ask you few questions.

myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.speaker: Radigad Ponfit
myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.text: Sure, go ahead. I'll answer as best I can.

steps.speaker: Radigad Ponfit
steps.text: I help with anything I can. I used to be a mercenary before joining the Myreque so I know my way around a blade. I've relied on Veliaf's sword arm many a time. I like to think that he can rely on mine.

options.text: What can you tell me about the Myreque?

steps.player: What can you tell me about the Myreque?

steps.speaker: Radigad Ponfit
steps.text: We're the only resistance against the vampyres. We're seriously outnumbered though. Veliaf doesn't like to hear us saying 'hopeless' but that's our situation at the minute.

options.text: What're your plans for the future?

steps.player: What're your plans for the future?

steps.speaker: Radigad Ponfit
steps.text: That's more a question for Veliaf. Ultimately though, our goal is to rid Morytania of the vampyres so that we might reclaim our right to exist.

steps.speaker: Radigad Ponfit
steps.text: For me personally, I hope that more people will join our ranks soon. Strengh comes in numbers after all.

steps.speaker: Radigad Ponfit
steps.text: I have. Something you might find interesting is that Safalaan Hallow, the leader of another Myreque group, has apparently managed to sneak one of his people into the vampyre capital, Darkmeyer.

steps.speaker: Radigad Ponfit
steps.text: I'm not sure how true that is. It would be great though!

options.condition: If the player has asked a question (replaces 'I'll be back later'):

myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.text: If first time speaking:

steps.speaker: Polmafi Ferdygris
steps.text: Ah, I see you've introduced yourself to Veliaf. Now, what can I do for you?

steps.player: Do you mind if I ask a few questions?

myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.text: If speaking again:

steps.speaker: Polmafi Ferdygris
steps.text: Salutations! How are you?

steps.player: Fine thanks. I'd like to ask a few questions if that's okay?

myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.speaker: Polmafi Ferdygris
myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.text: Not at all. I'm sure I'll be able to help.

steps.speaker: Polmafi Ferdygris
steps.text: I'm a key advisor to Veliaf. He seeks my council on many issues before we engage the enemy. Not that we do that very often. Our foes heavily outnumber us.

steps.speaker: Polmafi Ferdygris
steps.text: We don't give up though. After all, all that is required for evil to survive is for good people to do nothing.

options.text: What can you tell me about the Myreque?

steps.player: What can you tell me about the Myreque?

steps.speaker: Polmafi Ferdygris
steps.text: Well there's multiple groups of us. Even we don't know exactly how many. The less we know about our allies, the less we can reveal to the vampyres if captured.

steps.speaker: Polmafi Ferdygris
steps.text: Veliaf leads this group. We operate throughout Mort Myre and the surrounding villages. He reports to Calsidiu who is the head of our resistance.

options.text: What do you know about Morytania?

myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.player: What do you know about Morytania?

myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.speaker: Polmafi Ferdygris
myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.text: All the land on this side of the Salve is known as Morytania. Humans and vampyres are the main occupants of the region, though other races also live out here.

myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.speaker: Polmafi Ferdygris
myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.text: The humans here live like cattle with the vampyres taking regular blood tithes to keep themselves fed. All in all, it's a dire place. Though we hope to change that.

steps.speaker: Polmafi Ferdygris
steps.text: Yes, I hear them all the time. They're neither correct or even all that interesting though.

options.condition: If the player has asked a question (replaces 'I'll be back later'):

myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.text: If first time speaking:

steps.speaker: Sani Piliu
steps.text: Hello. Very nice to meet you! The name's Sani Piliu. What's yours?

steps.player: I'm [player name]. Nice to meet you Sani.

steps.speaker: Sani Piliu
steps.text: The pleasure's all mine! I've got a good feeling about you. I reckon you're going to do great things for us! You have a powerful aura. Sorry, that must seem really strange.

steps.player: Well, perhaps a little. It's nice of you to say so in any case though. I'd like to ask a few questions if that's okay?

myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.text: If speaking again:

steps.speaker: Sani Piliu
steps.text: Oh, hello [player name]. Nice to see you again! How's things?

steps.player: Fine thanks. Do you mind if I ask a few questions?

myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.speaker: Sani Piliu
myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.text: Sure, go ahead. I'll answer as best I can.

options.text: Tell me a bit about yourself.

steps.player: Tell me a bit about yourself.

steps.speaker: Sani Piliu
steps.text: There's not much to tell really. I was nine years old when my family was ripped to pieces by a vampyre.

steps.speaker: Sani Piliu
steps.text: One moment I was a happy member of a loving family, the next I was an orphan living a hand to mouth existence.

steps.speaker: Sani Piliu
steps.text: Somehow I managed to get by, eking out a living wherever I could. People took pity on me and I earnt food by helping them out.

steps.speaker: Sani Piliu
steps.text: I quickly found I had a very useful set of skills and there were plenty of people willing to pay for them.

steps.speaker: Sani Piliu
steps.text: I bumped into Veliaf in Canifis. He saw that I would be an asset to the Myreque and invited me to join. I said yes of course. I couldn't turn down the chance to fight against those who took away my family.

options.text: What can you tell me about the Myreque?

steps.player: What can you tell me about the Myreque?

steps.speaker: Sani Piliu
steps.text: Well Veliaf is the leader of our group. We're not the only ones in Morytania though. Veliaf reports to someone called Calsidiu who's in charge of all the Myreque. I've never met any of the others though.

steps.speaker: Sani Piliu
steps.text: Our hope is to one day bring an end to the reign of Lowerniel Drakan and his vampyres.

steps.speaker: Sani Piliu
steps.text: For now though, we're just trying to find any weaknesses we can take advantage of. We need to know how to kill them before we take the war to them!

steps.speaker: Sani Piliu
steps.text: With determination you can achieve great things. However, Veliaf always tells us not to underestimate the enemy. I've made that mistake before. I won't be making it again.

steps.speaker: Sani Piliu
steps.text: The entire region is ruled over by Lowerniel Drakan and his family. Everyone living here must pay blood tithes to the vampyres. The tithes keep the vampyres fed and ensure that people are too weak to oppose them.

steps.speaker: Sani Piliu
steps.text: That's where we come in. We won't just offer our family members to the Drakans as a weekly snack. We're going to fight back!

steps.speaker: Sani Piliu
steps.text: It's our only camp! At least, for our group. I know there's more Myreque in other parts of Morytania but I don't know exactly where.

options.condition: If the player has asked a question (replaces 'I'll be back later'):

myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.text: If first time speaking:

steps.player: Hi there. Veliaf said that I should introduce myself to everyone.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Okay. Well my name is Ivan. It's nice to meet you.

steps.player: Would you mind if I asked you a few questions?

myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.text: If speaking again:

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Oh, hello again. How are you?

steps.player: Fine thanks. Would you mind if I asked you a few questions?

myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.speaker: Ivan Strom
myreque-hideout-speaking-to-myreque-memb.text: That's fine. I don't know how much I can help though.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Me personally? I shouldn't be here really. I'm training to be a priest and I was meant to travel to Paterdomus to learn from Drezel. The trip's too dangerous at the moment though.

steps.player: Is it really important for you to train as a priest? I'd have thought there'd be more pressing issues.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Veliaf thinks it would be useful to have a priest to advise him. I think he also wants me further away from harm until I'm more experienced.

options.text: What can you tell me about the Myreque?

steps.player: What can you tell me about the Myreque?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: We're the only ones brave enough to put up a fight against the Drakans. I'm proud to be one of them.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I do worry that I might let the others down though. I'm not as skilled as they are.

options.text: What do you know about Morytania?

steps.player: What do you know about Morytania?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: It's a lost land. The evil Drakan family rule all of the region. People cling to each other in fear when the blood tithes are to be paid. It's horrible!

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: It won't be like this forever though. The Myreque will bring light back to this dark place.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Sorry, but I haven't heard anything notable recently.

options.condition: If the player has asked a question (replaces 'I'll be back later'):

myreque-hideout-speaking-to-veliaf-after.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
myreque-hideout-speaking-to-veliaf-after.text: Well met. I see you've introduced yourself to everyone. Shall we discuss those weapons now? Or was there something else you wanted to talk about?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Let's see what you have for us.
If the player does have the weapons:
You give the weapons to Veliaf.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: These weapons look great! Many thanks.
Cutscene begins

steps.speaker: Harold Evans
steps.text: What the...

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Vampyre!

steps.speaker: Sani Piliu
steps.text: It's Vanstrom!

steps.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
steps.text: Well done adventurer! You led me right to them. The little dears are going to wonder which side you're on!

steps.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
steps.text: The Drakans have been wanting you lot dealt with for a while now. We wouldn't want to disappoint them, would we?

steps.speaker: Sani Piliu
steps.text: We're dead!
Vanstrom casts blood barrage hitting and killing Sani for 30 HP

steps.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
steps.text: Quite right.

steps.speaker: Harold Evans
steps.text: No!

steps.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
steps.text: Sorry Harold, you too!
Vanstrom casts blood barrage hitting and killing Harold for 40 HP

steps.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
steps.text: And now... A little gift for the rest of you.
Vanstrom summons a Skeleton Hellhound; Cutscene ends
If the player does not have the weapons:

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Ah. I'm afraid you don't have suitable weapons for us. Sorry friend.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Well we all have our own specialisms. We could do with a longsword, two shortswords, a dagger, a mace and a warhammer, all made from steel.

steps.player: Okay. I'll come back once I have them.

options.text: So you're the leader of this group?

steps.player: So you're the leader of this group?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: That's right. I can't say I particularly asked for it. The others look up to me though, so they decided I was the best man for the job.

options.text: Can you tell me about your organisation?

steps.player: Can you tell me about your organisation?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Well I wouldn't say we're an organisation. We're really not that organised.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Anyway though, we're a group of Myreque freedom fighters. We're dedicated to mounting a resistance against the Drakan family and their vampyre kin.

options.text: What can you tell me about Morytania?

steps.player: What can you tell me about Morytania?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: If legend is to be believed, it was once a beautiful place. But then Lowerniel Drakan and his vampyres arrived.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Lowerniel Vergidiyad Drakan is his full name. He's the vampyre that heads up the Drakan family. Helped by his brother Ranis and his sister Vanescula, he rules over all of Morytania.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: So would you if you lost everyone dear to you at the hands of such monsters.

options.text: What are your plans for the future?

steps.player: What are your plans for the future?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: At the moment we're maintaining a low profile here at our hideout. We were recently spotted while out on a scouting mission so we're playing it safe and lying low.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Looking further ahead, we need to build more support if we have any hope of taking on the vampyres. We also need to learn more about their weaknesses, so we can take advantage of them.

options.condition: If the player has asked a question (replaces 'I'll be back later'):

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Sani... Harold... That murderer killed them!

steps.player: I'm so sorry. This is all my fault.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: I don't understand though. He said you led him here. How?

steps.player: He was the one that asked me to bring the weapons to you. He looked like a human though.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: I'm sorry friend, but he clearly took advantage of you. Vampyres can shapeshift to look like humans. Someone from around here might have realised. You were not to know though.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: The burden of what happened here is for your conscience to bear. That said, you managed to kill that pet of his. We might all be dead if not for you.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: I imagine you now see why we fight for our freedom.

steps.player: Yes. I think I understand. Is there anything I can do to help now? I first met Vanstrom in Canifis. I could go back and see if he's still there?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: I suspect he will have moved on now. You're welcome to try though. I know a shortcut that you might find useful.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: If you head back into the main cave and go north you'll reach a wall. There's a hidden door in that wall that leads right into the basement of the Hair of the Dog Tavern.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Once you are done, I'd appreciate you coming back here to discuss a few things. You held your own against that creature. We could use someone like you.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Need something?

options.text: I want to join your organisation.

steps.player: I want to join your organisation.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Well we could definitely use someone like you. You should go and see if Vanstrom is still in Canifis though. Come back once you're done, and we'll talk.

options.text: What do you plan to do now?

steps.player: What do you plan to do now?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: We won't be able to stay here now that Vanstrom knows where we've been hiding. We have some time though. He'll expect that we're all dead. We'll use that time to form a plan of action.

options.text: How do I get out of here again?

steps.player: How do I get out of here again?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: If you head back into the main cave and go north you'll reach a wall. There's a hidden door in that wall that leads right into the basement of the Hair of the Dog Tavern.

myreque-hideout-after-defeating-the-skel.speaker: Radigad Ponfit
myreque-hideout-after-defeating-the-skel.text: That monster! He killed them! We'll make them all pay!

myreque-hideout-after-defeating-the-skel.speaker: Polmafi Ferdygris
myreque-hideout-after-defeating-the-skel.text: This is a dark day for the Myreque.

myreque-hideout-after-defeating-the-skel.player: I'm so sorry for your loss.

myreque-hideout-after-defeating-the-skel.speaker: Polmafi Ferdygris
myreque-hideout-after-defeating-the-skel.text: Don't worry. No one blames you. You were tricked and that's that. It serves no useful purpose to blame any of ourselves for this.

myreque-hideout-after-defeating-the-skel.speaker: Ivan Strom
myreque-hideout-after-defeating-the-skel.text: Thank Saradomin you managed to kill that awful beast! I just wish we could have done more.

myreque-hideout-after-defeating-the-skel.player: I'm so sorry for your loss. If there's anything I can do, please let me know.

myreque-hideout-finishing-up.speaker: Stranger
myreque-hideout-finishing-up.text: Hello friend. What can I do for you?

myreque-hideout-finishing-up.player: Oh, sorry. I thought you were someone else.

myreque-hideout-finishing-up.speaker: Stranger
myreque-hideout-finishing-up.text: Who did you think I was?

myreque-hideout-finishing-up.player: I thought you were that dirty murderer Vanstrom.

myreque-hideout-finishing-up.speaker: Stranger
myreque-hideout-finishing-up.text: Woah! It sounds like you've got a score to settle!
